rows.jyutping: hai2 hou2 daai6 aat3 lik6 haa6
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when an action is performed while the person is under considerable stress.

example.english: I worked stressfully to finish the report on time.
example.traditional: 我喺好大壓力下趕住交份報告。
